Regulatory stability on food/drink pricing and halal certification is lowering compliance risk, enabling faster product launches and margin expansion for compliant consumer companies.
sectors.ai: Buy selective mid-cap consumer names showing volume-backed breakouts (COIN, BTEK, ADES) while large-cap FMCG lags; the ID/US spread favors local exposure. Rotate into water/health-hygiene plays (ADES, NSSS) as staples demand re-rates, but trim any position that fails to hold 7% gains within 5 sessions.

sectors.name: Logistics
themes: Indonesia's coal and nickel export volumes remain structurally sticky, underpinning demand for heavy-equipment logistics and marine haulage despite global commodity price volatility.

US freight forwarders (EXPD, CHRW) are pricing in a global restocking cycle, which historically leads Indonesian export logistics volumes by 2-3 quarters, supporting forward earnings visibility.
sectors.ai: Buy logistics selectively: TRUK's +25% confirms tight-supply haulage pricing power, while SOCI and RMKE ride coal/commodity volume tailwinds. US freight names (EXPD, CHRW) signal global rate inflection, but Indonesia's domestic movers (TAXI, PSAT) offer higher beta. Accumulate TRUK and RMKE on pullbacks; avoid BLOG's speculative run.
